test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which of the following options regarding the recent Lancet findings on global violence statistics, which was released in December 2025, is ***incorrect***?

options.text: Over 1 billion individuals aged 15+ had experienced sexual violence during childhood in 2023
Around 608 million females were exposed to intimate partner violence in 2023
India’s estimated intimate partner violence prevalence among women aged 15+ was 23 percent
About 15 percent of women globally have experienced childhood sexual violence

solution:
The correct answer is __**About 15 percent of women globally have experienced childhood sexual violence.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Lancet published global estimates revealing that over 1 billion people aged 15 and above had experienced sexual violence as children in 2023.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The incorrect statement is the claim that only 15 percent of women globally have experienced childhood sexual violence, which contradicts the reported figure of over 1 billion total survivors.**
 
• **The Lancet estimated around 608 million females were exposed to intimate partner violence in 2023.**
 
• **India recorded an estimated 23 percent prevalence of intimate partner violence among women aged 15 and above.**
 
• **More than 30 percent of Indian women and 13 percent of men aged 15+ reportedly faced sexual violence during childhood.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Intimate Partner Violence (IPV)**__

 __
 
• Refers to physical, sexual or emotional abuse committed by a current or former partner.
 
• A major public health issue, especially prevalent in South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
 
 
 
• **Childhood Sexual Violence**__
 __
 
• Includes any sexual act forced on a person before age 18.
 
• Associated with long-term consequences such as mental health disorders, trauma and chronic diseases.
 
 
 
• **The Lancet**__
 
 
• One of the world’s most respected medical journals known for global health data and peer-reviewed research.
 
• Its estimates highlight urgent public health and policy interventions required worldwide.
